activePrice-Tip: The Active Price is the condition that triggers a TrailingStop exit strategy. When the Last Traded Price reaches orexceeds the Activation Price, the Trailing Stop order isactivated. Once the order is activated, the system begins tocalculate the Stop Market Order price based on the highest(for Long positions) or lowest (for Short positions) and it'sretracement amount in either a predetermined percentageor price distance. If an Activation Price is not specified bythe user, the Trailing Stop order will be active as soon as itis set up.

Any unfilled limit or market orders will appear in the corresponding Limit Order or Market Order records under Current Orders.
